title: DAC evaluation
description_1: My master project was an evaluation of a project that was already done by Action Against Hunger (AHH) a Spanish Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that have a base in Lebanon. The project is composed of three main components: Supporting Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises, Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance distribution assistance, and providing IYCF counseling for vulnerable pregnant or lactating women (PLW). The OECD DAC Network on Development Evaluation (EvalNet) has defined six evaluation criteria – relevance, coherence, effectiveness, efficiency, impact, and sustainability. The final evaluation will be based on the DAC evaluation, where the six criteria was analyzed to produce the final report of my project.
